source.snippet: How to configure both Q-Series and C-Series vGPU profiles on Proxmox Host with single Nvidia L40s GPU. Need to run docker container with gpu and assign Q-series vGPU profile to Windows Server on same host. (score 3, 1 comment, captured 2026-09-02)

problem_statement: ML/AI infrastructure operators running Proxmox with high-end Nvidia GPUs (L40s, A100) struggle to configure vGPU profiles so a single physical GPU can simultaneously serve GPU-accelerated containers and Windows VMs — forcing them to either buy additional cards or leave expensive capacity idle.
target_segment: DevOps engineers and self-hosted ML infrastructure operators at small AI labs, agencies, or startups running Proxmox with enterprise-grade Nvidia GPUs.
notes: The Nvidia L40s is a ~$10,000+ GPU card — this operator has already made a significant hardware investment and is trying to maximize utilization. Pain is real and technical. Opportunity: a step-by-step setup guide/service or a managed Proxmox vGPU configuration tool. Single signal, moderate engagement — signal strength kept at 2 pending corroboration from other sources.
